[EVENT] User recently rearranged their living room furniture and is looking for throw pillow recommendations.

[PREFERENCE] User prefers throw pillows that complement the modern feel of their living room and add a pop of color.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested bold geometric patterns in contrasting colors like navy blue, emerald green, or yellow for throw pillows.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommended velvet pillows in rich hues like burgundy, mustard, or teal to add depth and sophistication.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested abstract art-inspired designs and pillows with metallic accents to complement the modern feel of the living room.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Specific pillow designs mentioned include:  
- A navy blue and white geometric patterned pillow from West Elm  
- A velvet pillow in a rich, burgundy color from CB2

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided options for mustard velvet pillows from West Elm, Crate & Barrel, and AllModern.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided options for teal velvet pillows from CB2, Urban Outfitters, and Jonathan Adler.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested checking Etsy for unique, handmade options and thrift stores for vintage finds.  
[PREFERENCE] User likes the idea of velvet pillows in rich hues, specifically mustard or teal.  
[EVENT] User plans to check out options from West Elm and CB2.  
[PREFERENCE] User is considering starting with one pillow in a bold, rich color and ordering swatches or samples to see which one they like best.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant advised to test swatches in different spots around the living room to see how they look in various lighting conditions.
